extract_inverted_list_contents: extract list IDs and codes from a FAISS inverted list at a given list index
get_inverted_list_sizes: get an array of sizes for all inverted lists in a FAISS index
extract_PQ_centroids: extract product quantizer centroids as a 3D numpy array from a FAISS PQ object
extract_linear_transform_matrix: extract the transformation matrix and bias vector from a FAISS PCA or linear transform object
create_linear_transform_from_matrix: create a FAISS LinearTransform object from a numpy matrix and optional bias vector
